summary.text: Peter Bauer is the Democratic candidate for Alaska State Senate District O in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A physician and U.S. Air Force veteran, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he supports an 18-month ban on new data centers in Alaska.

paragraphs.text: Peter Bauer graduated from Falls High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Bemidji State University in 1981 and an M.D. from Mayo Medical School in 1985, and received a graduate degree from the University of Utah in 1996.
He served in the U.S. Air Force from 1986 to 2006 and worked as a physician.
Bauer advanced from the August 18, 2026 nonpartisan primary and faces incumbent George Rauscher (R) and Ryan Sheldon (R) in the general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Bauer said he favors universal access to quality health care, expanded rural and tribal health systems, and increased funding for public education.
He also said he supports wind, solar, hydro and geothermal energy development alongside other energy sources.
